'''Regency Spires Imperial Trust''' was a bank that operated on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ralltiir/Legends|Ralltiir]] during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Led by the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Bosrik Mak-Ageejay]], the trust was one of the few banks on Ralltiir to weather the Empire's [[Subjugation of Ralltiir|subjugation]] of the world in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], due to the fact that the majority of its clientale were [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officers]] and advisors. However, unknown to the bank's clients, Mak-Ageejay secretly used the bank's funds to purchase arms for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="Coruscant and the Core Worlds" />
